desc:
🏨 WELCOME TO MY HOTEL!

HOW TO PLAY:

🛎️ Help Your Guests — Carry their luggage and make their stay amazing!
🔑 Manage Reception — Welcome guests and check them into your hotel!
🧹 Keep It Clean — Clean rooms and keep your guests happy!
🍳 Serve Delicious Food — Cook meals for your hungry guests!
👥 Grow Your Team — Hire staff to help run your hotel!

💰 Earn While You're Away — Purchase the Offline Earnings upgrade to make money even when you're offline!
